author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Super AI Fighters - a sort of playable web-based arcade game.

100% vibe code and vibe design.  I hooked up Claude Code with Nano Banana and let Opus 4.6 ran for 2 hours, then I have a sort of working game.  I still have to adjust the size and positioning of the characters though. 

Here is the link to play
https://lnkd.in/gFYzFKWZ
